title: 🤯 The Most Shocking Political Poll I’ve Seen in Years | Chris Cillizza
description:
🚨 A stunning new Gallup poll finds that 89% of Americans believe corruption is widespread throughout the U.S. government—the highest number ever recorded.

That’s not just a Republican or Democratic problem. Democrats, independents, and Republicans alike overwhelmingly believe Washington is corrupt. And compared with other major democracies, the United States stands out in a very bad way. 🇺🇸📉

In this video, I break down what’s driving this historic collapse in trust, including Donald Trump’s massive financial gains since returning to the White House, the growing concern over politicians using public office for private benefit, and the seemingly endless stream of ethics scandals involving members of both parties. 💰🏛️

Most importantly: what does this mean for the 2026 midterm elections? Could corruption become a powerful secondary issue that helps fuel a backlash against the party in power? 🗳️

Watch, then let me know in the comments: Do you think corruption in Washington is getting worse—or are Americans simply paying closer attention?
